style: Weathered white and steel-grey painted metal, chunky readable shapes, strong silhouette, soft studio lighting from the upper left, game inventory icon style, high detail. Plain flat background, no text, no labels, no numbers, no border, no shadow on the ground.

pictures.sensor: Four small robot sensor packages, each a compact sensor cluster about as wide as tall: a large round camera eye with a blue glowing lens in a bolted housing; a twin-lens optical scanner block with orange lenses and a short antenna; a small radar dish with a red glowing receiver on a swivel mount; a bolted housing with three small green lenses under a short visor hood plate.
pictures.servo: Four small robot manipulator gripper parts, each a compact servo actuator lying horizontally: a two-finger parallel gripper on a short servo housing; a three-prong claw on a ball joint; a flat pincer clamp with an exposed cable loop; a stubby magnetic grabber with a ring coil. One accent color each: blue, orange, red, green.
pictures.drive: Four small robot drive units, each a compact locomotion motor assembly: a wedge-shaped foot housing on two small wheels with a blue status strip; a compact tank tread unit with orange hub lights; a single large wheel in a fork bracket with a hub motor and a red light; a hover repulsor pad with green emitter rings underneath.
pictures.cell: Four small robot power cells, each a compact battery unit lying horizontally: a ribbed cylinder with a glowing blue charge window; a hexagonal cell with amber glowing end caps; a twin-barrel pack in a metal bracket with a red status light; a rounded capsule with three glowing green rings.
pictures.logic: Four small robot logic modules, each a plug-in computer cartridge standing upright, about twice as tall as wide: a slim circuit cartridge with gold contact pins and a blue processor window; a finned heat-sink processor block with an orange indicator strip; a data core rod in a metal cage with a red glowing center; a stacked memory wafer module with green status lights.
pictures.socket: Four small robot expansion sockets, each a compact round port fitting facing the viewer: a round multi-pin socket in a bolted ring with a blue center; a hexagonal port with gold contacts and an orange rim light; a twist-lock coupling socket with a red core; a square-flanged data port with green contact lights.
pictures.emitter: Four small robot energy shield emitters, each a compact projector standing upright, taller than wide: a dish emitter on a short pylon with a blue lens; a three-pronged field projector holding an orange crystal; a domed emitter node on a ribbed base with a red ring; a tall coil emitter with green bands between metal fins.
